analysis_sections.text: The reconstruction retains a recognizable head and glasses while redistributing the background and facial appearance into banded, repeated structure. The original crop shows the actual speaking expression. This authentic example makes the display distinction especially clear: a transformed, textured reconstruction can accompany an authentic assessment. Such texture is an effect of the graph-filtered view, not by itself a manipulation cue or an original-image defect.

analysis_sections.text: The readouts sum in the authentic direction for each displayed pair, which is reflected in predominantly blue contribution maps. A few small positive cells in the middle pair show that an authentic classification does not require every patch to have the same sign. The full signed readout matters. It supports the model’s overall direction without turning individual blue cells into independently verified authentic pixels.

analysis_sections.text: The unsigned attention response is relatively restrained, and the fixed-area connected selection still appears as part of the common inspection interface. In this authentic control, a highlighted central region should therefore be understood as a proposal for viewing the model features, rather than a detected manipulation.
